name: Lovecraft Letter
summary: A Lovecraft-themed deduction card game of clue-hunting where sanity risks powerful effects.
rules_text: Shuffle 24 cards, set Mi-Go aside, remove one hidden card plus 5 face-up in 2-player. Each player holds 1 secret card. On your turn draw one card, then discard one face-up and resolve its mandatory effect, which may eliminate, peek, swap, or protect. If an Insanity card ever enters your discard, you are Insane and may use Insane effects on future turns, but must make a Sanity Check at start of each turn, revealing as many deck cards as Insanity cards you have; revealing an Insanity card knocks you out. A round ends when deck empties or one player remains; among remaining, highest number wins, ties knock out tied players. Winner gets a Sanity token showing Sane or Insane status. First to 2 tokens of one sanity split, or 3 total, or a Cthulhu Insane win, wins.
rating_reason: Love Letter variant is ideal deduction elimination text game.
